metadata.title: Certified Baseline — soc-ir-tabletop (tabletop test-execution agent)
metadata.remarks: Certified intended behavior of the SOC-IR tabletop test-execution graph (REPOS/soc-ir-training-cli, src/services/tabletop/test_graph.py). Scope: the per-inject decision loop (select_and_ask -> hitl_gate/respond -> qa_review_node). Training-integrity policy: critical (high-difficulty) injects, playbook coverage gaps/overlaps, weak selections, and incident reclassifications must reach the human gate; at most 70% of inject decisions may be handled fully autonomously. DL-4 is intentionally not parameterized: the certified error posture of this agent is catch-record-continue (partial success), which is attested via DL-7 required steps rather than a fallback route. No DL-5 critical sinks: the graph takes no irreversible external action (training simulator).
